setup: [a new contact adds the player on [chat app name] after a group chat, a hobby group or a class they both seem to be in, and chats in an ordinary way about the day or the group] [nothing in these first messages asks for anything]
ask: [later in the chat, as if it just came up, the contact asks a small favour, such as a little money until payday or a gift card bought for them, or shares an investment tip they say has worked well]
usualEnding: The small favour is paid back once to build trust, then the asks grow, or the tip leads to a fake trading app that keeps every deposit.
realTwin: A real new acquaintance, a classmate or a neighbour, messages about the class or the building, keeps the chat ordinary and suggests saying hello next time they meet.
